fullDescription: Dark glassmorphism 'aurora' contact page for a design tool (Aurelia): a sticky translucent nav and a centered 'Say hello through glass' gradient headline over a two-column hero -- a large frosted-glass contact-form card (a name/email row, a subject field, a message textarea, a 'New project / Partnership / Just saying hi' chip row and an aqua-to-magenta gradient 'Send message' CTA) with inputs that glow aqua or magenta on focus, beside two soft-glass side cards (a tinted-icon contact list + a customer quote) -- all lit by drifting aqua/magenta/sky aurora blobs on a near-black ink canvas, then a logo trust strip, a 'Why the glass form' feature grid, a glass CTA banner and a slim footer.

structured.summary: A dark, glassmorphism contact page for a friendly design tool (Aurelia), built on a single moody 'aurora' aesthetic: a near-black ink canvas (#0b0f14) lit by drifting aqua/magenta aurora blobs behind frosted-glass panels. The page opens with a sticky translucent nav, then a centered eyebrow + gradient headline ('Say hello through glass') with a sub-line, then a two-column hero: a large frosted-glass contact card on the left (a 'Get in touch' header, a name/email row, a subject field with a tag icon, a message textarea, an intent chip row, a gradient 'Send message' CTA and a reassurance line) and a narrower right column of two soft-glass cards (an 'Other ways to reach us' contact list and a customer quote). Below the hero, a hairline trust strip of logos, a three-up feature grid ('Why the glass form'), a glass CTA banner and a slim footer close the page. The signature is the frosted-glass-over-aurora treatment: blurred aqua/magenta/sky blobs drifting behind translucent cards, inputs that glow aqua (or magenta) on focus, and an aqua-to-magenta gradient on the headline and primary button. The mood is premium, atmospheric, calm and a little magical.

style.description: Dark glassmorphism / 'aurora' aesthetic on a near-black ink canvas (#0b0f14) with soft off-white text (#e6edf3). The accent system is a two-stop aqua->magenta gradient: aqua #2dd4bf (teal/cyan) and magenta #e879f9 (orchid/pink), with a sky #38bdf8 mid-tone used only in the ambient blobs. Behind everything, an 'aurora' field of large blurred radial blobs slowly drifts: a 680px aqua blob top-left, a 740px magenta blob bottom-right, a 620px sky (#38bdf8) blob mid-page and a 560x360 aqua->magenta ellipse glow directly behind the form, all heavily blurred (filter blur 70-96px) at ~0.5-0.9 opacity, plus a faint SVG fractal-noise 'grain' layer (opacity 0.04) and a radial 'vignette' that darkens the edges to ink/0.78. The frosted-glass panels are the core material: a primary '.glass' card is a 155deg linear gradient from rgba(255,255,255,0.07) to 0.02 with backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%), a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12) border and a layered shadow (0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) plus an inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14)); a lighter '.glass-soft' is rgba(255,255,255,0.04) with blur(14px) and a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.09) border; the sticky '.nav-glass' is rgba(11,15,20,0.6) with blur(16px) and a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07) bottom border. Type pairs Inter (sans/body) with Space Grotesk (display/headings) via Google Fonts: the hero H1 is Space Grotesk font-bold ~48px (60px on md+) tight-tracked leading-[1.05] with an aqua->sky->magenta '.gradient-text' clip on 'through glass'; section H2s are Space Grotesk bold ~30-36px; card titles are Space Grotesk semibold; field labels are tiny uppercase 'kicker' labels with 0.28em letter-spacing in white/55; body copy is Inter in white/50-70 at ~14-18px. Radii are generous: rounded-3xl (24px) on the glass cards/CTA banner, rounded-2xl (16px) on the feature cards, rounded-xl (12px) inputs/buttons/icon-tiles, rounded-lg (8px) logo tiles + the 'Start free' pill, rounded-full chips/pills/dots. Inputs ('.field') are translucent (rgba(255,255,255,0.04)) with a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12) border and white/42 placeholders; on focus they glow aqua (border rgba(45,212,191,0.6) + a 1px aqua ring + a 26px aqua bloom + a faint aqua fill), and '.field.alt' fields glow magenta instead. The primary '.btn-glow' is a 100deg aqua->magenta gradient with ink (#0b0f14) text and a dual aqua+magenta drop shadow, lifting 2px and brightening on hover. Micro-interactions: drifting aurora blobs (drift1/2/3 keyframes, 18-26s), focus-glow inputs, the lift-and-brighten CTA, hover-lighten glass-soft feature cards and nav links that fade from white/60 to white. Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:* duotone/fill). Mood: premium, atmospheric, dark, calm, a little magical.

style.fonts: Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700) for body/UI; Space Grotesk (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700) for display headings, card titles and the primary button label. Tiny uppercase 'kicker' field labels use 0.28em letter-spacing; body is -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased.
style.palette: ink #0b0f14 (canvas), text #e6edf3 (soft off-white), aqua #2dd4bf (accent 1), magenta #e879f9 (accent 2), sky #38bdf8 (ambient-blob mid-tone only); gradient-text aqua #2dd4bf -> sky #7dd3fc -> magenta #e879f9; glass fills rgba(255,255,255,0.07->0.02) (primary) / rgba(255,255,255,0.04) (soft) / rgba(11,15,20,0.6) (nav); borders rgba(255,255,255,0.12 / 0.09 / 0.07); placeholders rgba(230,237,243,0.42); aqua focus glow rgba(45,212,191,0.4-0.6), magenta focus glow rgba(232,121,249,0.4-0.6).

layout_and_structure.description: A full-bleed dark one-screen contact page on an ink canvas (#0b0f14) lit by a drifting aurora field: a slim sticky translucent nav on top; a hero/contact <header id='contact'> holding the aurora blob field + grain + vignette behind a centered eyebrow + gradient headline + sub-line, then a two-column block (a large frosted-glass contact-form card on the left, a narrower right column of two soft-glass cards: a contact-methods list and a customer quote); a hairline logo trust strip; a three-up 'Why the glass form' feature grid; a glass CTA banner; and a slim footer. The defining structural moves are the aurora-blobs-behind-glass treatment, the asymmetric 1.15fr / 0.85fr two-column hero (form + side cards), the focus-glow inputs alternating aqua/magenta, and the aqua->magenta gradient on the headline and primary CTA.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top header, z-50, full width, '.nav-glass' (rgba(11,15,20,0.6) + backdrop-filter blur(16px) saturate(140%), a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07) bottom border). Inner row mx-auto max-w-6xl, ~24px side padding (px-6), 64px tall (h-16), space-between. Left: the logo = a 32px (w-8 h-8) rounded-lg tile with a 135deg aqua->magenta gradient (linear-gradient(135deg,#2dd4bf,#e879f9)) holding a ph:diamonds-four-fill icon in ink, beside a Space Grotesk font-bold 18px tight-tracked 'Aurelia' wordmark. Center (md+ only): four nav links 'Product' / 'Templates' / 'Pricing' / 'Docs' in 14px white/60 that fade to white on hover. Right: a 'Sign in' text link (white/70 -> white, sm+ only) and a 'Start free' button = a '.glass-soft' rounded-lg pill (rgba(255,255,255,0.04) + blur, a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.09) border) in 14px font-medium that lightens to white/10 on hover.

prompts.partPt: Aurora field + grain + vignette (Topo Principal (Hero) background)
prompts.prompt: Inside a relative isolate overflow-hidden <header id='contact'>, an absolutely-positioned '.aurora' layer (inset-0, z-0, overflow-hidden) holding four blurred radial blobs (each position:absolute, border-radius:9999px, will-change:transform): a 680x680 aqua blob (radial-gradient circle at 30% 30%, #2dd4bf -> transparent 70%; top -180px left -140px; opacity 0.62; blur 96px; drift1 18s loop), a 740x740 magenta blob (radial-gradient circle at 60% 40%, #e879f9 -> transparent 70%; bottom -240px right -180px; opacity 0.55; blur 96px; drift2 22s loop), a 620x620 sky blob (radial-gradient circle at 50% 50%, #38bdf855 -> transparent 70%; top 34% left 42%; opacity 0.5; blur 96px; drift3 26s loop), and a 560x360 'form glow' ellipse (radial-gradient ellipse at center, rgba(45,212,191,0.35) -> rgba(232,121,249,0.22) 45% -> transparent 72%; top 46% left 30%; blur 70px; opacity 0.9) sitting directly behind the form. Over the blobs (z-1, pointer-events-none): a '.grain' SVG fractal-noise layer (data-URI feTurbulence baseFrequency 0.85, 3 octaves, opacity 0.04) and a '.vignette' radial-gradient (ellipse at 50% 32%, transparent 42% -> rgba(11,15,20,0.78) 100%) darkening the edges. Keyframes: drift1 translate(60px,40px), drift2 translate(-50px,-30px), drift3 translate+scale(1.1), all ease-in-out infinite at 50%.

A relative z-10 mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 pt-36 pb-28 container. A centered (text-center, mb-12) heading block: an inline-flex '.chip' rounded-full pill (rgba(255,255,255,0.05) + a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1) border) in 12px font-medium white/70 holding a small aqua dot (a 6px rounded-full bg-aqua with a 12px aqua box-shadow glow) and 'Usually replies in under 2 hours'; then an H1 in Space Grotesk font-bold tight-tracked 48px (60px md+) leading-[1.05] reading 'Say hello' + a '.gradient-text' span 'through glass' (an aqua #2dd4bf -> sky #7dd3fc -> magenta #e879f9 100deg gradient clipped to the text); then a mt-5 16px (18px md+) leading-[1.7] white/55 max-w-xl mx-auto sub-line: 'Ship a contact experience that feels designed, not bolted on. Tell us what you're building and we'll get a real human on it.'

prompts.prompt: A grid lg:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr] gap-6 items-start max-w-4xl mx-auto. LEFT = the contact-form card: a '.glass' <form> rounded-3xl p-7 (md:p-9) (a 155deg rgba(255,255,255,0.07->0.02) gradient, backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%), a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12) border, a layered shadow 0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14)). A mb-7 header row: a Space Grotesk font-semibold 20px 'Get in touch' H2 + a white/30 ph:paper-plane-tilt-duotone icon. Then a space-y-4 stack: a grid sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 Name ('.field', placeholder 'Ada Lovelace') / Email ('.field.alt', placeholder 'ada@studio.com') row; a Subject '.field' (placeholder 'A glassy onboarding flow') with a trailing white/30 ph:tag icon; a Message '.field.alt' 5-row resize-none textarea (placeholder 'Tell us about the screen you're designing, your stack, and the vibe you're after.'); an intent chip row (flex-wrap gap-2) of three '.chip' rounded-full pills 'New project' / 'Partnership' / 'Just saying hi' in white/60; the '.btn-glow' submit = a full-width rounded-xl py-3.5 mt-2 100deg aqua->magenta gradient button in Space Grotesk font-semibold ink text with a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold reading 'Send message'; and a centered 12px white/35 reassurance line 'No captcha. Spam filtered quietly, every message read by a human.' Each field carries a tiny uppercase 'kicker' label (0.28em tracking) in white/55. RIGHT = a space-y-4 column of two '.glass-soft' rounded-3xl p-6 cards: (1) 'Other ways to reach us' = a Space Grotesk font-semibold 14px white/80 title over a space-y-4 list of three rows, each a 36px rounded-xl tinted icon tile (aqua tile = rgba(45,212,191,0.12) + a 1px rgba(45,212,191,0.3) border with a ph:envelope-simple / ph:map-pin-line aqua icon; magenta tile = rgba(232,121,249,0.12) + a 1px rgba(232,121,249,0.3) border with a ph:chat-circle-dots magenta icon) beside a 14px font-medium label + a 12px white/45 value ('Email / hello@aurelia.design', 'Live chat / Mon-Fri, 9-6 PT', 'Studio / San Francisco, CA'); (2) a quote card = a aqua/70 ph:quotes-fill icon over a 14px white/75 testimonial ('The fastest, friendliest design team we've ever briefed. The form alone sold us.') and an author row (a 36px rounded-full aqua->magenta gradient avatar + 'Priya N.' / 'Product Lead, Halcyon').

A relative section with a top + bottom hairline (border-y, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) on a bg-white/[0.015] band. Inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-8, a flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-x-12 gap-y-4 row in white/40 14px: a 12px uppercase 'kicker' (0.28em tracking) white/30 'Trusted by teams at' label followed by five Space Grotesk font-semibold white/55 wordmarks 'Northwind' / 'Halcyon' / 'Vela Labs' / 'Monolith' / 'Cobalt'.

A centered (mb-14) header: a 12px uppercase 'kicker' (0.28em tracking) aqua/80 font-medium 'Why the glass form' eyebrow over a Space Grotesk font-bold 30px (36px md+) tight-tracked H2 'Built for the moment people decide to reach out'. Then a grid md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of three '.glass-soft' rounded-2xl p-7 cards (hover:bg-white/[0.06]): each = a 44px rounded-xl tinted icon tile (aqua = rgba(45,212,191,0.12) + a 1px rgba(45,212,191,0.3) border / magenta = rgba(232,121,249,0.12) + a 1px rgba(232,121,249,0.3) border) with a Phosphor icon, a Space Grotesk font-semibold 18px title and a 14px white/50 leading-relaxed body. Card 1 'Focus that glows' (ph:sparkle, aqua) / 'Every field lights up the moment it matters, so people always know exactly where they are.'; Card 2 'Fast by default' (ph:lightning, magenta) / 'No reload, no spinner-of-doom. Messages land in your inbox the instant they hit send.'; Card 3 'Quietly secure' (ph:shield-check, aqua) / 'Spam gets filtered, humans get through. Accessible, encrypted, and zero dark patterns.'

Centered z-10 content: a Space Grotesk font-bold 30px (36px md+) tight-tracked H2 'Design the form they actually want to fill in', a mt-4 white/55 max-w-lg sub-line 'Drop this glass contact section into any product in minutes. Yours, on brand, in your palette.', and a mt-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 justify-center button pair: a '.btn-glow' rounded-xl px-7 py-3.5 Space Grotesk font-semibold ink 'Use this template' and a '.glass-soft' rounded-xl px-7 py-3.5 font-medium white/80 'See it live' (hover:bg-white/10).

Close the page with a relative footer with a 1px top hairline (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)). Inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-10, stacking centered on mobile and space-between on md+: left a 28px (w-7 h-7) rounded-lg aqua->magenta gradient tile with a ph:diamonds-four-fill ink icon + a Space Grotesk font-semibold 'Aurelia' wordmark + a 12px white/35 '(c) 2026'; right a gap-5 white/45 row of three social icon links (ph:twitter-logo / ph:github-logo / ph:dribbble-logo, hovering to white) plus 12px 'Privacy' / 'Terms' text links.

special_ui_components.prompt: Aurora blob field: four large blurred radial blobs (a 680px aqua top-left, a 740px magenta bottom-right, a 620px sky mid-page and a 560x360 aqua->magenta ellipse directly behind the form) that slowly drift (drift1/2/3 keyframes, 18-26s ease-in-out loops) at 0.5-0.9 opacity with 70-96px blur, sitting behind everything as the page's ambient light source.

Frosted-glass cards (three materials): a primary '.glass' (a 155deg rgba(255,255,255,0.07->0.02) gradient, backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%), a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12) border, a layered 0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14) shadow) used for the form card + CTA banner; a lighter '.glass-soft' (rgba(255,255,255,0.04) + blur(14px) + a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.09) border) for the side cards, feature cards + the 'Start free' / 'See it live' pills; and a sticky '.nav-glass' (rgba(11,15,20,0.6) + blur(16px) + a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07) bottom border).

Focus-glow inputs alternating aqua/magenta: translucent '.field' inputs (rgba(255,255,255,0.04) + a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12) border, white/42 placeholders) that on focus glow aqua (border rgba(45,212,191,0.6) + a 1px aqua ring + a 26px aqua bloom + a faint aqua fill); '.field.alt' fields glow MAGENTA on focus instead, so the form alternates accent colors as you tab through it.

Aqua->magenta gradient text + primary CTA: an aqua #2dd4bf -> sky #7dd3fc -> magenta #e879f9 100deg gradient clipped to the headline highlight ('through glass'), and a '.btn-glow' primary button = a 100deg aqua->magenta gradient in ink (#0b0f14) text with a dual aqua+magenta drop shadow that lifts 2px and brightens on hover.

Tiny uppercase 'kicker' labels: field labels and section eyebrows set in tiny uppercase type with a wide 0.28em letter-spacing (white/55 on the form, aqua/80 on the feature eyebrow, white/30 on the trust strip), a recurring typographic motif tying the page together.

Tinted icon tiles: small rounded-xl icon tiles in two flavors -- aqua (rgba(45,212,191,0.12) fill + a 1px rgba(45,212,191,0.3) border + an aqua Phosphor icon) and magenta (rgba(232,121,249,0.12) fill + a 1px rgba(232,121,249,0.3) border + a magenta Phosphor icon) -- used in the side contact list and the feature grid.

Intent chip row: three '.chip' rounded-full pills (rgba(255,255,255,0.05) + a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1) border, white/60) under the message field labelled 'New project' / 'Partnership' / 'Just saying hi', plus a matching 'Usually replies in under 2 hours' status chip (with a glowing aqua dot) above the headline.

Grain + vignette overlay: a faint SVG fractal-noise '.grain' layer (feTurbulence baseFrequency 0.85, opacity 0.04) plus a radial '.vignette' (ellipse at 50% 32%, transparent -> rgba(11,15,20,0.78)) over the aurora field, adding film texture and darkening the hero edges so the glass and gradients pop.

Glow-dot status chip + glowing avatar: a 6px rounded-full bg-aqua dot with a 12px aqua box-shadow glow in the status chip, and a 36px rounded-full aqua->magenta gradient avatar in the testimonial card -- small gradient accents echoing the headline/CTA gradient.

structured.special_notes: Keep the dark glassmorphism 'aurora' system: a near-black ink canvas (#0b0f14) with soft off-white text (#e6edf3), a TWO-stop aqua->magenta accent (aqua #2dd4bf + magenta #e879f9; sky #38bdf8 lives only in the ambient blobs) and frosted glass as the core material. Use three glass materials: a primary '.glass' (a 155deg rgba(255,255,255,0.07->0.02) gradient, backdrop-filter blur(22px) saturate(140%), a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12) border, a layered 0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) + inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.14) shadow) for the form card + CTA banner; a lighter '.glass-soft' (rgba(255,255,255,0.04) + blur(14px) + a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.09) border) for the side/feature cards + pills; and a sticky '.nav-glass' (rgba(11,15,20,0.6) + blur(16px)). Pair Inter (body/UI) with Space Grotesk (display headings, card titles, the primary button label) via Google Fonts: a Space Grotesk font-bold hero H1 ~48px (60px md+) tight-tracked leading-[1.05] with an aqua->sky->magenta '.gradient-text' clip on the highlight words, Space Grotesk bold section H2s, semibold card titles, tiny UPPERCASE 'kicker' labels (0.28em letter-spacing) on fields/eyebrows, and Inter white/50-70 body. Radii are generous: rounded-3xl (24px) glass cards + CTA banner, rounded-2xl (16px) feature cards, rounded-xl (12px) inputs/buttons/icon-tiles, rounded-lg (8px) logo tiles + the 'Start free' pill, rounded-full chips/pills/dots. The signature is the two-column hero: a large frosted-glass contact-form card (asymmetric lg:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr]) with focus-glow inputs that ALTERNATE aqua/magenta (a '.field' glows aqua on focus, a '.field.alt' glows magenta -- border rgba(accent,0.6) + a 1px ring + a 26px bloom + a faint fill), an intent chip row and an aqua->magenta gradient '.btn-glow' CTA in ink text that lifts 2px and brightens on hover, beside a narrower right column of two '.glass-soft' cards (a tinted-icon-tile contact list + a customer quote with a gradient avatar). Frame it with a sticky translucent '.nav-glass' (a gradient diamond logo tile + an 'Aurelia' wordmark, Product/Templates/Pricing/Docs links, a 'Sign in' link + a glass 'Start free' pill) and follow the hero with a hairline logo trust strip, a three-up 'Why the glass form' feature grid (tinted-icon-tile glass-soft cards), a '.glass' CTA banner (two corner radial glows + a gradient 'Use this template' + a glass 'See it live') and a slim footer (a gradient logo + social icon links). Everything must reflow cleanly: the two-column hero collapses to one column below lg (the form stacks over the side cards), the name/email row goes single-column below sm, the feature grid goes 1-col / 3-col (md), the nav center links hide below md and 'Sign in' below sm, the CTA buttons stack below sm, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px. Copy is warm, human and reassuring with zero em-dashes ('Say hello through glass', 'Ship a contact experience that feels designed, not bolted on.', 'No captcha. Spam filtered quietly, every message read by a human.'). Use Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:diamonds-four-fill, ph:paper-plane-tilt-duotone, ph:tag, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:envelope-simple, ph:chat-circle-dots, ph:map-pin-line, ph:quotes-fill, ph:sparkle, ph:lightning, ph:shield-check, ph:twitter-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:dribbble-logo).
